verdict.rationale: A password manager with a CLI and programmatic secret retrieval could plausibly publish an API reference, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only a CLI and app features, with no interactive API reference or runnable examples. The probes found no llms.txt or markdown docs. The CLI is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
